hud_visibility.config.title: HUD Visibility
hud_visibility.tooltip.allow: ON allows eligible content; OFF hides it. F3+B / F3+G must still be enabled manually.
hud_visibility.tooltip.hitboxes: Allows F3+B hitboxes, eye-height and direction lines.
hud_visibility.tooltip.player_names: Includes player names and below-name scores. Team and visibility rules still apply.
hud_visibility.tooltip.entity_names: Names of entities other than players and text_display.
hud_visibility.tooltip.text_display_name: The optional custom name above a text_display entity, separate from its text.
hud_visibility.tooltip.text_displays: The text and background of text_display entities, separate from their name tags.
hud_visibility.tooltip.hands: Both first-person hands and held items. Respects camera, sleep and spectator mode.
